purpose: Reference-led review sheet of five single-wavefront EMP directions, each shown at three uniform runtime scales.
layout: Five numbered candidate columns; each column shows the same wavefront at approximately 15, 55, and 100 percent radius.

current_runtime_truth.gameplay_resolution: Damage, stun, and projectile clearing resolve immediately across the full radius when charge completes.
current_runtime_truth.visual_resolution: The current authored EMP raster appears immediately at full radius and only fades; it does not propagate outward.
current_runtime_truth.charge_center_mismatch: The charge cue is currently fixed at the position where charge starts, while release gameplay and the release raster use the player's position when charge completes.

proposed_presentation_contract.release_timeline: Keep gameplay resolution at release. Scale one authored wavefront from about 15 percent to 100 percent radius over about 0.20 seconds, then finish the existing 0.55-second lifetime with a quick fade.
proposed_presentation_contract.origin_alignment: Start the wavefront at the actual release position. Any later integration must also keep the charge cue aligned with that release truth while the player moves.
proposed_presentation_contract.selected_asset_contract: One transparent 512x512 raster with a 256x256 center pivot; no frame sequence.
proposed_presentation_contract.interior_behavior: The area behind the moving wavefront clears instead of remaining a persistent field.

directions: Broad faceted circular pressure band with four large breaks
Wide digital-blackout band with four bold dropout cuts
Near-circular front built from four unequal broad arc plates
Stepped industrial pulse band with large silhouette cuts

reference_research.takeaway: A thrown EMP is recognized by immediate shield and electronics disablement in an area.
A charged source produces one area blast that damages shields, slows targets, and destroys traps.
A top-down vehicle EMP reads clearly as one blue wavefront moving away from the vehicle.
The visible wavefront is a gameplay metaphor for electromagnetic propagation, not literal visible electricity.

generation.prompt_summary: Five original Cardborne-styled single EMP wavefronts shown at three expansion phases; no blades, petals, lightning, particles, persistent field, or copied named-game asset.
